problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate a fleet of delivery vehicles from four distribution centers to four retail warehouses, minimizing the total fuel expenditure.

The number of vehicles available at each distribution center (set C) is as follows:
*Center C1 has 163 vehicles ready.
*Center C2 has 190 vehicles ready.
*Center C3 has 75 vehicles ready.
*Center C4 has 62 vehicles ready.

The required number of vehicles at each retail warehouse (set W) is fixed:
*Warehouse W1 requires 157 vehicles.
*Warehouse W2 requires 5 vehicles.
*Warehouse W3 requires 26 vehicles.
*Warehouse W4 requires 217 vehicles.

The fuel cost per vehicle dispatched from a given center to a specific warehouse is detailed in the table:
| From / To | W1 | W2 | W3 | W4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | 8 | 6 | 14 | 16 |
| C2 | 16 | 7 | 13 | 2 |
| C3 | 6 | 13 | 1 | 13 |
| C4 | 9 | 15 | 10 | 14 |

Determine the optimal vehicle dispatch plan to achieve the minimal total fuel cost.
